title: Atlas Copco: Sweden’s Best Kept Secret - [Business Breakdowns, EP. 71]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: This is Matt Reustle and today we are breaking down the Swedish industrial giant, Atlas Copco.
reader_summary.overview: This is Matt Reustle and today we are breaking down the Swedish industrial giant, Atlas Copco. With a market cap hovering around $50 billion US dollars, Atlas Copco is a dominant player in the air compressor and vacuum pump markets. It has returned 40x over the past 20 years for its shareholders and to break down the business I’m joined by Stephen Paice.

key_points.text: It has returned 40x over the past 20 years for its shareholders and to break down the business I’m joined by Stephen Paice.
Baillie Gifford has owned this business for 4 decades and Stephen still has the handwritten research notes from the mid-80s so we thought it was a proper fit..
We cover the rich corporate history.
